bills.summary_ai: This bill directly addresses the regulation of veterinary technicians through licensure requirements, scope of practice definitions, continuing education mandates, and disciplinary procedures. It establishes exemptions for both licensed and unlicensed veterinary technicians and defines what services they may provide under veterinarian supervision.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: An Act Authorizing Certain Foreign-educated Veterinarians To Practice Under A Temporary Permit And The Establishment Of A Veterinarian-client-patient Relationship Through The Use Of Telehealth For The Treatment Of Urgent Medical Conditions.
bills.summary_ai: This bill expands veterinary service access by allowing foreign-educated veterinarians to practice under temporary permits and permits telehealth establishment of veterinarian-client-patient relationships for urgent conditions. While primarily focused on veterinarians, it indirectly affects paraprofessional workforce by potentially increasing demand for veterinary technicians and assistants to support expanded service delivery models.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: An Act Concerning Credit Cards And Health And Veterinary Care Services.
bills.summary_ai: This bill restricts how veterinary care providers, including paraprofessionals, can offer medical credit cards to consumers and regulates billing practices for veterinary services and ancillary products. It impacts the financial transaction responsibilities and consumer disclosure obligations of veterinary practices where paraprofessionals work.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: An Act Concerning State Law Protections For Health Care Providers And Patients Related To The Provision Of A Legally Protected Health Care Activity.
bills.summary_ai: This bill extends state law protections for health care providers and patients regarding legally protected health care activities. Depending on how veterinary paraprofessionals are defined under state law, this could provide legal protections for veterinary technicians, nurses, and other paraprofessionals when performing within their authorized scope of practice.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Sunset Pet Animal Care & Facilities Act
bills.summary_ai: This bill extends licensing requirements for pet animal care facilities under the Pet Animal Care and Facilities Act, which directly impacts where veterinary paraprofessionals work and the standards they must maintain in those facilities. The sunset review and continuation of facility licensing regulations affects operational standards and compliance requirements for veterinary paraprofessionals employed in licensed pet care settings.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Access to Veterinary Care
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses access to veterinary care through multiple mechanisms including expedited licensing for veterinarians, clarification of prescription drug use, and drug donation programs. While primarily focused on veterinarian licensure and drug regulations, these provisions directly impact the scope of practice and responsibilities of veterinary paraprofessionals who work under veterinary supervision and handle prescribed medications.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine.

It adds new sections governing veterinary paraprofessionals and repeals existing regulatory provisions, directly affecting the scope of practice, licensure, and regulatory framework for veterinary technicians and related paraprofessional roles.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Criminal history information: background checks.

categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Antimicrobial resistance.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Res. Chapter 103, Statutes of 2026.
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses antimicrobial resistance, which directly impacts veterinary paraprofessionals who administer medications, prepare pharmaceuticals, and assist in infection control protocols. Paraprofessionals play a critical role in implementing antimicrobial stewardship practices and preventing resistance development in clinical settings.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine: cat declawing.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 479, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends veterinary medicine regulations regarding cat declawing procedures, which directly impacts what veterinary paraprofessionals are permitted to perform under veterinary supervision. categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Registered veterinary technicians and veterinary assistants: scope of practice.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 371, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends California's Business and Professions Code to define and potentially expand the scope of practice for registered veterinary technicians and veterinary assistants. categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinarians: veterinarian-client-patient relationship.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State. Chapter 589, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends regulations regarding the veterinarian-client-patient relationship (VCPR), which is a foundational legal requirement that governs how veterinarians can delegate tasks to and supervise veterinary paraprofessionals. Changes to VCPR requirements directly impact what work veterinary technicians, nurses, and assistants are legally permitted to perform under veterinarian supervision.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine: California Veterinary Medical Board.

categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)
